analysis.summary: Kovai Medical Center and Hospital Limited reported a 16% revenue growth for FY 2025-26, driven by strong occupancy and higher ARPOB. The company maintained a 29% EBITDA margin and a 15% PAT margin, while continuing to invest in advanced medical technology and infrastructure. Management announced plans to construct a 300-bed pediatric hospital, with work expected to commence in the second quarter of 2026. The company also highlighted its commitment to clinical excellence, including significant investments in oncology and neurosciences. Kovai Medical Center and Hospital Limited reported a 12.43% increase in operating income for FY 2024-25, reaching Rs.

guidance.claim: The company achieved a 12% growth compared to the previous year.
guidance.quote: We have achieved a 12% growth compared to 2023-24.

guidance.claim: The company reported a profit margin of 15%.

demand_outlook.claim: Revenue growth was driven by strong occupancy and higher ARPOB.
demand_outlook.quote: The year 2025-26 continues to exhibit good performance, having posted a 16% growth in revenue against 12% in 2024-25, driven by strong occupancy and higher ARPOB (Average Revenue Per Occupied Bed).

demand_outlook.claim: The medical college is experiencing high demand for admissions, with all seats currently filled.
demand_outlook.quote: The Medical College has experienced significant growth over the past years, with a substantial increase in patient intake. Their reputation has become so esteemed that there is now high demand for admission to this prestigious medical school, with all seats being filled.

capex_expansion.claim: The board approved the construction of a 300-bed pediatric hospital.
capex_expansion.quote: The board has approved for constructing 300 bed Paediatric Hospital at the main center premises and the work may commence during the second quarter 2026.

capex_expansion.claim: The company invested ₹120 Crore in a new Institute of Neuro Sciences & OPD Block.
capex_expansion.quote: Representing a capital investment of ₹120 Crore, this state-of-the-art facility operates as a vertical hub of medical excellence.

capex_expansion.claim: The company invested ₹47 Crore in advanced oncology and diagnostics.
capex_expansion.quote: We launched Tamil Nadu’s first Varian ETHOS AI-powered Adaptive Radiation Therapy system, part of a ₹47 Crore investment in advanced oncology and diagnostics and continue to lead the state in performing CAR-T cell therapies.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to add 100 beds to its main campus.
capex_expansion.quote: We will add another 100 beds in the main campus.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is planning a new 300-400 bed hospital in Chennai.
capex_expansion.quote: In addition we are planning a 300-400 bed hospital in Chennai.

capex_expansion.claim: The new OP block is expected to be ready for operation by the end of the year.
capex_expansion.quote: The OP block will be ready for operation by this year end.

capex_expansion.claim: The company invested 5239.02 Lakhs in medical equipment during the 2023-24 financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: Investment in equipment during the year 2023-24 amounts to ` 5239.02 Lakhs.

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved an EBITDA margin of 29% and a PAT margin of 15%.
margins_costs.quote: Your hospital has posted a robust EBITDA margin of 29%, which is excellent compared to the current industry standards, and has shown a sustained PAT (Profit After Tax) margin of 15%.

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved an EBITDA of 36,263.68 Lakhs for the financial year 2023-24.
margins_costs.quote: Earnings before interest, tax, depreciation and amortization (EBITDA) were ` 36,263.68 Lakhs over the previous year EBITDA of ` 28,450.10 Lakhs.

orders_capacity.claim: The hospital currently operates with a 2000 bed capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: Congratulations. Our Hospital is a 2000 bed hospital.

capital_allocation.claim: The board recommended a dividend of ₹15 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: Based on Company’s performance, the Board of Directors are pleased to recommend a dividend of ₹15/- per share (150%) for the Financial Year 2025-26 subject to the approval of the members.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a 100% dividend for the financial year.
The company is seeking approval to increase borrowing limits to Rs. 2500 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: Therefore, it is considered desirable to enhance the borrowing limits to ` 2500 crore (Rupees Two thousand five hundred crore only) apart from temporary loans obtained / to be obtained by the company from its Bankers in the ordinary course of business.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a dividend of 10 per share for the 2023-24 financial year.
capital_allocation.quote: Based on company’s performance, the Board of Directors are pleased to recommend a dividend of ₹ 10/- per share (100%) for the Financial Year 2023-24 for approval of the members.

risks_headwinds.claim: Rising costs of consumables, employees, and financing are impacting margins.
risks_headwinds.quote: Rising cost of consumables, employee expenditure and financing cost shrinks our margin.

risks_headwinds.claim: There is a limited availability of skilled workforce and medical professionals.
risks_headwinds.quote: An inherent weakness in our operations is the limited availability of skilled workforce and medical professionals.

risks_headwinds.claim: The healthcare industry faces challenges related to the shortage of skilled medical professionals.
risks_headwinds.quote: The shortage of skilled medical professionals is a pressing issue in the healthcare industry, impacting institutions like KMCH and their ability to deliver quality care effectively.

risks_headwinds.claim: Regulatory requirements impose significant compliance costs and administrative burdens on the company.
risks_headwinds.quote: Regulatory requirements present significant challenges to the healthcare industry. Compliance costs, administrative burdens, lengthy approval processes, and potential legal consequences for non-compliance all work as a deterrent to the organization, demanding substantial investments of time and money to meet the legal requirements.

management_commitments.claim: Construction of a 300-bed pediatric hospital is planned to commence.
management_commitments.quote: The board has approved for constructing 300 bed Paediatric Hospital at the main center premises and the work may commence during the second quarter 2026.

management_commitments.claim: The company will add 100 beds to the main campus.
management_commitments.quote: We will add another 100 beds in the main campus.

management_commitments.claim: The company is planning a 300-400 bed hospital in Chennai.
management_commitments.quote: In addition we are planning a 300-400 bed hospital in Chennai.

management_commitments.claim: The OP block will be ready for operation by the end of the year.
management_commitments.quote: The OP block will be ready for operation by this year end.

management_commitments.claim: Dr. Nalla G Palaniswami has been re-appointed as Managing Director for a period of five years effective from October 1, 2024.
management_commitments.quote: The Board in its meeting held on 25th May, 2024 had resolved to re-appoint Dr.Nalla G Palaniswami for a period of five years with effect from 01st October, 2024.

management_commitments.claim: Mrs. V. Bhuvaneshwari has been re-appointed as an Independent Director for a second term of five years.
management_commitments.quote: Upon the recommendations of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee, the Board of Directors at their meeting held on 25th May, 2024, have resolved to re-appoint Mrs.V.Bhuvaneshwari as an Independent Director of the Company for another term of five consecutive years from 3rd September, 2024 to 2nd September, 2029

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
